options.name: Extended Effect
options.benefit: Spend up to 1 phrenic point, increasing to 2 at 11th, 3 at 15th, and 4 at 19th level, to extend a condition imposed by an offensive manifestation by 1 round per point.

options.name: Faithful Creature
options.benefit: Spend 1 phrenic point so a thoughtform creature can persist without attacking, can be maintained with swift-action concentration, and deals half psychic backlash damage.

options.name: Punishing Thought-form
options.benefit: Spend 1 phrenic point to increase an offensive manifestation's damage die by one step.

options.name: Reciprocal Defense
options.benefit: Spend 1 phrenic point with a defensive manifestation to gain a +2 insight bonus to physical AC, increasing to +3 at 11th level and +4 at 15th level.
